## Statement · **draft**
Let $A$ be an integral domain. On the set $A \times (A \setminus \{0\})$ define

$(a, s) \sim (b, t) \iff a t = b s .$

This is an equivalence relation; the quotient set is denoted $\operatorname{Frac}(A)$, its elements are written $\frac{a}{s}$, and with the operations

$\frac{a}{s} + \frac{b}{t} := \frac{a t + b s}{s t}, \qquad \frac{a}{s} \cdot \frac{b}{t} := \frac{a b}{s t}$
